fullDescription: A sophisticated, minimalist design system tailored for academic portfolios, high-end consulting, or professional dossiers. Characterized by 'Plus Jakarta Sans' typography, a neutral slate-and-stone color palette (#0F172A, #475569), and an editorial layout style. It features high-contrast sections, ultra-rounded corners (up to 3rem/48px), glassmorphism navigation, and subtle mesh gradients. Ideal for industry leaders, researchers, and luxury service providers seeking a clean, authoritative presence with smooth micro-interactions like 3D lifts and pulse indicators.
prompt:
## Resumo
A centered minimalist professional portfolio featuring heavy editorial typography, a muted slate-toned color palette, and high-impact whitespace. The design balances a clean white 'vibrant mesh' background with deep slate dark-mode sections for project showcases.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design using 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Typography hierarchy: Hero headings at 72px/font-black/leading-0.95; Section headings at 48px/font-black; Body text at 20px-24px/font-medium/color-#475569. Color Palette: Background #FFFFFF, Primary Dark #0F172A, Muted Slate #475569, Accent Gray #94A3B8, Card BG #F8FAFC. Elements should have extreme border radii (32px-48px). Use a 'vibrant-mesh' background effect consisting of multiple radial-gradients at 0%, 50%, and 100% with #475569 at 8% opacity. Buttons should use a linear-gradient(135deg, #475569 0%, #0F172A 100%) with a hover state transition of 'all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' and a 'translateY(-4px)' transform. Include a 'section-divider' element: 8px tall, 120px wide with a horizontal gradient from #475569 to #3F3F3F.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Sticky header with 'backdrop-blur-xl' and 'bg-white/80'. Height 80px. Left side: Branding with a 40x40px rounded-2xl logo icon (rotated 3 degrees) and 20px font-extrabold title. Right side: Links in 14px font-bold, uppercase, tracking-widest, paired with a high-contrast 'vibrant-gradient' CTA button.

### Hero Section
Centered single-column layout. Top: Status badge (bg-#F8FAFC, border-#E2E8F0, text-12px font-black) with a 10px pulsing circle. Middle: Heavy heading (text-7xl, font-black) with specific color spans for 'Neural Architecture' (gradient #475569 to #64748B) and 'Social Cognition' (font-light, #94A3B8). Bottom: 24px font-medium body text max-width 42rem. Dual CTA buttons: one gradient-filled, one heavy-bordered (4px border-#0F172A).

### Featured Projects (Dark Mode)
Full-width section with 'bg-slate-900'. Header includes a 'section-divider' and a right-aligned 'Archive' button. Grid: 2-column layout. Cards: 'bg-slate-800/50', border-white/10, border-radius 3rem (48px), padding 32px. Cards feature an aspect-video placeholder with a central icon and a floating badge (NIH-2023 style) in the bottom-left.

### Publications (Grid/Sticky)
12-column grid layout. Left (col-span-4): Sticky header with title 'Selected Publications' and a gradient-text span. Right (col-span-8): Vertical list of cards. Cards: 'bg-stone-50', border-radius 2.5rem, 4px transparent border that turns #E2E8F0 on hover. Include a download icon button (56x56px, rounded-2xl, bg-slate-900) in each entry.

### Footer
Bg-#F8FAFC, border-t #E2E8F0. 4-column layout. Left (col-span-2): Large brand logo, 20px description, and social icons (56x56px squares, rounded-2xl, border-2 #E2E8F0). Right (2 columns): Vertical navigation lists with 12px uppercase tracking-widest headers and 18px font-bold list items.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Vibrant Mesh Background — A sophisticated subtle background effect using layered radial gradients.
Apply a background with three radial gradients: at 0% 0% (rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.08)), at 50% 0% (rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.08)), and at 100% 0% (rgba(63, 63, 63, 0.08)). Set background-color to #FFFFFF.

### Scholarly Publication Card — A specialized card for academic citations or research highlights.
Container: padding 40px, bg-#F5F5F4, border-radius 40px. Top-row: badge (bg-#F1F5F9, text-12px) and a large download button. Title: 30px font-black. Subtitle: 20px font-bold, italic, color-#64748B. Footer: Inline flex icons with text like '84 Citations' or 'Editor's Choice' using 18px font-black.

## Notas Especiais
Maintain extreme contrast between font weights (900 vs 300) to achieve the 'scholar' look. Never use sharp corners; every container must have at least a 16px radius, with main cards reaching 48px. Gradients must be subtle and limited to slate tones—avoid vibrant colors like blue or red to maintain academic integrity.

Animations are subtle, utilizing cubic-bezier curves for smooth lifts and pulses, with heavy use of radial gradients for depth.
